turns.brief:
A UGC-style clip of a gig worker's morning. 9:16 vertical, handheld phone camera movement. 

(0-3s) Close-up on hands holding a smartphone over a messy bedspread. A notification appears: "New Shift Available." A thumb taps it immediately. Natural morning window light. 

(3-6s) Medium close-up, handheld. A hand reaches out and grabs a canvas tote bag from the back of a wooden chair. 

(6-10s) Low angle, following the legs and the swinging bag as the person walks briskly through a bedroom doorway into a sun-drenched hallway. 

SOUND: Haptic phone buzz, the rustle of canvas, quick footsteps on floorboards, a door handle click. 

AVOID: Studio lighting, clean minimalist rooms, slow motion, cinematic depth of field.
